## Roadmap task
Link the task in ROADMAP.md.

## Changes
Explain user-visible behavior and implementation.

## Validation
- [ ] Python compilation succeeds
- [ ] Automated tests pass
- [ ] Data provenance and caveats are accurate
- [ ] Mobile layout reviewed if relevant
- [ ] No secrets or invented odds/predictions

## Risk / rollback
Describe known limitations and how to revert.

## Deployment
Do not merge or deploy until reviewed.
